capabilityPolicy.constructors: Only exact argument-label sequences in the manifest are recognized for property inspection; unlisted overloads stay read-only and unsupported.
capabilityPolicy.componentCalls: One unique local nongeneric View struct with a supported inferred memberwise initializer. Instance literals and described slots/actions are editable independently; shared-definition entry identifies affected call sites.
capabilityPolicy.closureSlots: Only known content builders are traversed. Action closures are preserved as source and never evaluated by the authoring model.
capabilityPolicy.propertyWriters: Phases 2–6 subset writers are implemented in packages/swift-sema/src/design-controls.ts and authoring-*.ts, enumerated in packages/shared/src/authoring-writers.ts. Commands validate project revision, ownership, signatures, source types and deployment target. Native/browser acceptance remains pending.
capabilityPolicy.unknownExpressions: Preserve source; do not infer editability from evaluated values.
capabilityPolicy.modifierOrder: Preserve each occurrence and its exact position, including repeated padding/background modifiers.
capabilityPolicy.collections: Logical row templates come from source. Typed local Identifiable arrays expose bounded record/schema editing and explicit field bindings. Preview records affect evaluation inputs only; app initial records change Swift through atomic transactions.
capabilityPolicy.scenarios: Versioned metadata holds explicit typed inputs with matching source signatures. Inputs replace evaluation AST initializers only, never Swift defaults. Arbitrary hooks are preserved but are not executed.

nativeReference.thresholdPolicy: Calibrate repeat-capture noise, compare corresponding content regions, and freeze thresholds only after real native evidence. Null is blocked, never zero or passing.
nativeReference.reason: Simulator runtime identity and regional image thresholds cannot be frozen until CoreSimulator execution and captures succeed. Existing references remain provisional.
